answer: Each submission hangs on the horizon of a task receipt, and the sable is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the knoll of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
